# Distribution archives

Installable MediaGallery test archives are generated by the GitHub Actions workflow **Build MediaGallery installable archive**.

The workflow is started manually with `workflow_dispatch` and creates:

```text
dist/mediagallery-VERSION.zip
dist/mediagallery-VERSION.zip.sha256
```

The ZIP contains a single top-level `mediagallery/` directory suitable for plugin installation/testing.

Generated ZIP files are uploaded as GitHub Actions artifacts and are not committed to the repository. Test artifacts are retained for 14 days.
